suno.estilo: Main theme, slow hymn-like ballad, bittersweet and hopeful. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. Lead vocal: adult female mezzo-soprano, pure airy tone, light vibrato, invented language sung with Spanish and Latin vowels. Choir: small mixed chamber choir, soft and distant. Fingerpicked guitar and lute open, low cello countermelody, psaltery shimmer, bells on phrase endings. Builds from solo voice to full choir, then falls back to voice and guitar. Soft frame drum only in the last chorus. Memorable, singable melody. D Dorian, 72 BPM, 4/4. Form: intro, verse, chorus, interlude, verse, chorus, bridge, outro.
